hint: It carries water and minerals.
easy_answer: Xylem transports water and dissolved minerals mainly from roots to other parts of the plant.

hint: It transports prepared food.
easy_answer: Phloem transports food made in leaves to other parts of the plant.

easy_answer: Transpiration is the loss of water vapour mainly through stomata of leaves.

hint: It helps in upward movement of water.
easy_answer: Transpiration contributes to the upward movement of water and minerals and cools the plant.

easy_answer: Circulation is the continuous movement of blood through the heart and blood vessels.

easy_answer: The heart is a muscular organ that pumps blood through the circulatory system.

easy_answer: Arteries are blood vessels that generally carry blood away from the heart.

easy_answer: Capillaries are tiny blood vessels where exchange of gases, nutrients and wastes occurs.

easy_answer: Lymph is a fluid that helps transport absorbed fats and supports fluid balance and immunity.

easy_answer: The kidneys are the main organs that filter blood and form urine.

easy_answer: A nephron is the structural and functional unit of the kidney.

easy_answer: Urine is the fluid produced by kidneys containing water and dissolved wastes.
